tagline: The Akamai WAF connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The Akamai WAF connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. The connector ingests web application firewall (WAF) security events from Akamai into Databricks.
why_it_matters: The connector ingests web application firewall (WAF) security events from Akamai into Databricks.
plain_summary: The Akamai WAF connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page.
key_takeaway: The Akamai WAF connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
